title: WWE Legends Elite Series 23 Rosey 6in Action Figure - New
descriptionText: This WWE Legends Elite Collection Series 23 action figure of Rosey stands at 6 inches tall and is a must-have for any wrestling fan. The figure features intricate details and comes from the popular Legends franchise. It is perfect for collectors or as a gift for someone who loves wrestling. The action figure is of high quality and is sure to bring a smile to anyone's face.
